name: Copia de Seguridad Diaria Completa (10:00 AM) - Gastromanager

nodes.name: Todos los días a las 10:00 AM

parameters.query: SELECT id, TO_CHAR(date::date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS fecha_es, time AS hora, CASE WHEN time < '17:00' THEN '☀️ COMIDA' ELSE '🌙 CENA' END AS turno, COALESCE(client_name, 'Sin nombre') AS cliente, pax AS personas, UPPER(LEFT(COALESCE(zone, 'interior'), 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTRING(COALESCE(zone, 'interior') FROM 2)) AS zona, COALESCE(phone, '-') AS telefono, COALESCE(notes, '-') AS notas_alergias, CASE WHEN status = 'confirmed' THEN 'Confirmada' WHEN status = 'seated' THEN 'En mesa' WHEN status = 'finished' THEN 'Finalizada' ELSE 'Otra' END AS estado_es FROM appointments WHERE status != 'cancelled' ORDER BY date DESC, time ASC;

SELECT json_build_object(
  'version', 1,
  'timestamp', now(),
  'app', 'RESTAURANTE VALDELAVILLA BACKUP TOTAL N8N',
  'appointments', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM appointments a),
  'settings', (SELECT COALESCE(data::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) FROM settings WHERE id = 'main' LIMIT 1),
  'tables', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM tables t),
  'providers', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM providers p)
) AS backup_json;
